rules.name: Missing WBS Reference
rules.objective: Detect budget, cost, schedule, or progress records that cannot be tied to a project WBS node.
rules.logic: For each domain record, wbs_node_id must resolve to an active WBS node for the same project. Missing or unresolved WBS creates a finding.
rules.threshold: Any unresolved WBS record; configurable minimum count = 1.
rules.evidence: Source dataset, original row number, source WBS value, project code.
rules.finding: {dataset} contains {count} records without a valid WBS reference.
rules.impact: Weak traceability; cost/progress/schedule rollups may be incomplete or misleading.
rules.recommendation: Map the source WBS to the canonical WBS tree or correct the source record before analysis.
rules.false_positive: Allow approved non-WBS records to be excluded by dataset mapping rule.
rules.acceptance: A test file with 5 unresolved WBS records produces exactly 5 evidence rows and 1 grouped finding.

rules.name: Duplicate Cost Transaction
rules.objective: Detect probable duplicate cost transactions introduced by repeated rows or repeated file imports.
rules.logic: Build a normalized duplicate key from project_id + transaction_date + vendor_code/name + po_number + document_number + amount + normalized description. Group count > 1.
rules.threshold: Duplicate group count >= 2; confidence increases when document_number or PO matches exactly.
rules.evidence: Duplicate record IDs, source row numbers, duplicate key fields, amounts.
rules.finding: {count} probable duplicate cost transactions detected across {groups} duplicate groups.
rules.impact: Can inflate actual cost, commitments, vendor exposure, and forecasts.
rules.recommendation: Verify source duplicates against invoice/document number and remove or mark repeated rows.
rules.false_positive: Permit legitimate split postings where document number differs or accounting status indicates separate posting.
rules.acceptance: Known duplicate pair is detected as one group; legitimate split pair is not grouped when document numbers differ.

rules.name: Contradictory Date or Progress Values
rules.objective: Identify records with internally inconsistent dates or progress values before control calculations.
rules.logic: Flag schedule rows where finish < start, actual finish < actual start, progress outside 0..1, or progress period is earlier than project planned start when disallowed.
rules.threshold: Any contradictory record; ingestion should reject hard-invalid values and retain evidence.
rules.evidence: Dataset, row number, offending fields, validation message.
rules.finding: {count} records contain contradictory date/progress values.
rules.impact: Can distort delay, SPI, progress, and health calculations.
rules.recommendation: Correct source values and re-import the affected dataset.
rules.false_positive: Project-specific exceptions must be explicitly configured rather than silently ignored.
rules.acceptance: Each invalid record is traceable to the original row and receives a deterministic validation reason.

rules.name: Orphan WBS Reference
rules.objective: Detect records referencing a WBS code that does not exist in the project canonical WBS tree.
rules.logic: Source WBS value is present but no matching canonical wbs_nodes row exists for the same project.
rules.threshold: Any orphan WBS; severity critical when orphaned amount exceeds 1% of project budget.
rules.evidence: Source WBS, project, affected records, aggregated amount/progress.
rules.finding: WBS {source_wbs} is not mapped to the project WBS tree; {count} records are affected.
rules.impact: Rollup leakage; affected costs/progress may disappear from management totals.
rules.recommendation: Create a mapping or add the missing WBS node after project-control approval.
rules.false_positive: None for active analysis; retired WBS can be supported through explicit alias/mapping.
rules.acceptance: A missing WBS with material cost is critical and appears in the evidence view.

rules.name: Vendor Identity Inconsistency
rules.objective: Detect the same vendor appearing under multiple codes/names that can fragment spend analysis.
rules.logic: Normalize vendor_name. Flag a normalized name mapped to >1 vendor_code, or one vendor_code mapped to materially different normalized names.
rules.threshold: At least 2 distinct identities; warning when affected spend > 2% of project actual cost.
rules.evidence: Vendor codes, names, transaction count, total amount.
rules.finding: Vendor identity inconsistency found for {normalized_vendor}; {identity_count} identities represent {amount}.
rules.impact: Vendor concentration and cost-driver analysis can be understated or duplicated.
rules.recommendation: Create a canonical vendor mapping and standardize future imports.
rules.false_positive: Joint ventures or legal entities may legitimately have separate codes; permit approved mapping exceptions.
rules.acceptance: Known alias set is grouped together while explicitly distinct legal entities remain separate when configured.

rules.name: Actual Cost Exceeds Budget
rules.objective: Detect WBS-level actual cost overruns against approved budget.
rules.logic: Aggregate actual amount and approved budget by project + WBS. Variance = actual - approved_budget. Trigger when variance > 0.
rules.threshold: Default: any positive variance; severity critical when variance_pct >= 10% or variance_amount >= configurable materiality.
rules.evidence: Budget record(s), all contributing actual transactions, WBS rollup.
rules.finding: WBS {wbs} actual cost exceeds approved budget by {variance_amount} ({variance_pct}).
rules.impact: Confirmed cost overrun at current reporting cut-off.
rules.recommendation: Review quantity/price variance, commitments, change orders, and coding before escalation.
rules.false_positive: Approved revised budget must replace the prior baseline used for the check.
rules.acceptance: Synthetic WBS with budget 100 and actual 124 returns variance 24 and 24%.

rules.name: Actual + Commitment Exceeds Budget
rules.objective: Detect likely future overrun where actual plus open commitment already exceeds approved budget.
rules.inputs: cost_records where cost_type in (actual, commitment), budget_records
rules.logic: Exposure = actual + commitment. Trigger when exposure > approved_budget.
rules.threshold: Warning when > 100%; critical when >= 110% or materiality threshold is exceeded.
rules.evidence: Budget, actual transactions, commitment transactions, PO numbers.
rules.finding: WBS {wbs} has committed exposure of {exposure} versus budget {budget}.
rules.impact: Forward-looking overrun exposure even if actual spend has not yet exceeded budget.
rules.recommendation: Review open PO values, remaining scope, pending variations, and potential decommitment.
rules.false_positive: Exclude commitments already cancelled/closed or fully reversed.
rules.acceptance: Open commitment pushes exposure from 98% to 106%; rule returns warning with correct evidence.

rules.name: Cost Spike vs Recent Run Rate
rules.objective: Detect sudden cost acceleration that warrants project-control review.
rules.logic: For each WBS, current_period_cost > trailing_3_period_average * (1 + spike_threshold). Only evaluate when at least 3 prior comparable periods exist.
rules.threshold: Default spike_threshold = 30%; configurable minimum absolute amount = 1% of BAC or project materiality.
rules.evidence: Current period cost, three-period baseline, ratio, underlying transactions.
rules.finding: WBS {wbs} cost increased {increase_pct} versus trailing 3-period average.
rules.impact: Potential acceleration, bulk procurement, coding issue, or emerging cost risk.
rules.recommendation: Inspect high-value transactions, PO releases, procurement timing, and coding changes.
rules.false_positive: Planned bulk purchases can be tagged as expected events.
rules.acceptance: A 40% spike above three-period average is detected; 20% spike is not.

rules.name: Vendor Concentration Risk
rules.objective: Detect excessive dependence on one vendor within project spend.
rules.logic: vendor_share = vendor_actual / project_actual for selected period or cumulative view.
rules.threshold: Default warning >= 40%; critical >= 60% when project configuration enables concentration monitoring.
rules.evidence: Vendor total, project total, share, top transactions.
rules.finding: Vendor {vendor} represents {share} of project actual cost.
rules.impact: Commercial concentration and change/claim dependency may be high.
rules.recommendation: Review scope dependency, outstanding commitments, commercial exposure, and alternatives.
rules.false_positive: Single-source contracts can be explicitly marked expected.
rules.acceptance: Vendor with 45% share creates warning; 35% does not.

rules.name: High-Value Transaction Outlier
rules.objective: Surface unusually large individual transactions relative to WBS or project budget.
rules.logic: Calculate WBS and project budget shares for each transaction. Trigger only when both materiality thresholds are met.
rules.threshold: Transaction >= 25% of WBS budget AND >= 3% of project budget.
rules.evidence: Transaction record, budget context, PO/document number, vendor.
rules.finding: Transaction {document} represents {share} of WBS budget and requires review.
rules.impact: Large transactions may contain quantity, price, coding, or timing anomalies.
rules.recommendation: Verify supporting document, approved scope, coding, and period allocation.
rules.false_positive: Known milestone or advance-payment transactions can be tagged expected.
rules.acceptance: Both inclusive thresholds must be met; missing either threshold produces no finding.

rules.name: High Cost with Low Progress
rules.objective: Detect WBSs where spend is materially advanced while physical progress remains materially low.
rules.logic: For same WBS and latest period: cost_pct = actual_to_date / budget; progress_pct = actual_progress. Trigger when cost_pct >= 80% AND progress_pct <= 50%.
rules.threshold: Default 80% cost vs <=50% progress; configurable by project type.
rules.evidence: Budget, actual-to-date, latest progress, period history, major transactions.
rules.finding: WBS {wbs} has consumed {cost_pct} of budget while progress is {progress_pct}.
rules.impact: Potential quantity/price issue, low productivity, front-loaded procurement, or scope accounting risk.
rules.recommendation: Perform cost-to-progress reconciliation and validate quantity, productivity, and procurement timing.
rules.false_positive: Front-loaded procurement packages should be tagged as expected.
rules.acceptance: 80% cost / 45% progress triggers; 75% / 45% does not.

rules.name: Overdue Activity
rules.objective: Detect incomplete activities whose baseline finish is before the analysis date.
rules.logic: actual_progress < 1 AND baseline_finish < analysis_date AND status not in completed/cancelled.
rules.threshold: Default any overdue activity; critical when activity is critical_flag=true or overdue_days >= 14.
rules.evidence: Activity, baseline finish, actual progress/status, analysis date, overdue days.
rules.finding: Activity {activity} is overdue by {days} days with progress {progress}.
rules.impact: Schedule slippage and potential downstream impact.
rules.recommendation: Confirm actual field status, recovery plan, and downstream dependencies.
rules.false_positive: Approved baseline changes must update the active baseline or be versioned explicitly.
rules.acceptance: Activity 10 days overdue creates warning; 14 days or critical activity creates critical.

rules.name: Baseline Finish Slippage
rules.objective: Detect completed activities that finished later than baseline.
rules.logic: actual_finish > baseline_finish. slippage_days = actual_finish - baseline_finish.
rules.threshold: Default warning >= 7 days; critical >= 14 days or project-configured threshold.
rules.evidence: Activity baseline and actual dates, slippage days.
rules.finding: Activity {activity} finished {slippage_days} days later than baseline.
rules.impact: Evidence of schedule variance and possible milestone impact.
rules.recommendation: Capture delay reason, responsibility, and lesson/action if material.
rules.false_positive: Approved rebaseline should be compared using the correct baseline version.
rules.acceptance: 8-day slippage is warning; 15-day slippage is critical.

rules.name: Critical Activity Delay
rules.objective: Prioritize delayed activities on the critical path.
rules.logic: critical_flag=true AND (overdue OR actual_finish > baseline_finish OR total_float_days < 0).
rules.threshold: Any critical activity meeting delay condition.
rules.evidence: Activity critical flag, dates, float, progress, status.
rules.finding: Critical activity {activity} is delayed/at risk and may affect project completion.
rules.impact: Potential direct impact to project completion or major milestone.
rules.recommendation: Escalate recovery plan, predecessors/successors, resources, and mitigation actions.
rules.false_positive: Critical flag must reflect the approved current schedule version.
rules.acceptance: A critical activity 1 day overdue creates a critical finding regardless of amount.

rules.name: Activity Progress Lag
rules.objective: Detect activities whose actual progress materially trails planned progress.
rules.logic: progress_lag = planned_progress - actual_progress. Trigger when lag exceeds threshold.
rules.threshold: Default >= 10 percentage points; critical >= 20 points for critical activities.
rules.evidence: Activity planned vs actual progress, dates, status.
rules.finding: Activity {activity} is {lag_pp} percentage points behind plan.
rules.impact: Early signal of schedule recovery requirement.
rules.recommendation: Validate field progress and determine root cause and recovery action.
rules.false_positive: Progress methodology changes must be reflected before analysis.
rules.acceptance: 11 pp lag triggers warning; 9 pp does not.

rules.name: Negative Total Float
rules.objective: Detect schedule activities with negative total float.
rules.logic: total_float_days < 0.
rules.threshold: Any negative float.
rules.evidence: Activity, float value, schedule version/date.
rules.finding: Activity {activity} has {float_days} days negative float.
rules.impact: Activity requires schedule recovery or network review to protect milestones.
rules.recommendation: Review driving path, constraints, calendars, and recovery options.
rules.false_positive: External interface constraints may be intentionally modeled; retain evidence and approval notes.
rules.acceptance: Float -1 creates critical finding; float 0 does not.

rules.name: WBS Progress Lag
rules.objective: Detect WBS-level actual progress materially behind plan for the latest reporting period.
rules.logic: progress_lag = planned_progress - actual_progress for latest period per WBS.
rules.threshold: Default >= 10 percentage points; critical >= 20 points or when linked to critical schedule activities.
rules.evidence: Latest progress record, prior periods, WBS.
rules.finding: WBS {wbs} is {lag_pp} percentage points behind plan.
rules.impact: Project delivery risk if gap persists.
rules.recommendation: Investigate workfront constraints, productivity, materials, resources, and schedule logic.
rules.false_positive: Milestone-weighted or earned-value methodologies should be configured consistently.
rules.acceptance: 12 pp gap creates warning; 8 pp gap does not.

rules.name: Progress Above 100 Percent
rules.objective: Detect source progress values that exceed logical maximums.
rules.logic: Flag any source actual_progress or planned_progress > 1.0, including values encoded as 100+ percent after normalization.
rules.threshold: Any value > 100%.
rules.evidence: Original source value, normalized value, row number.
rules.finding: Progress value {value} for {wbs/activity} exceeds 100%.
rules.impact: Can distort project progress and health calculations.
rules.recommendation: Correct source encoding and re-import.
rules.false_positive: None in canonical percentage field; alternate units must be transformed during mapping.
rules.acceptance: 101% is flagged; 100% is valid.

rules.name: Cost Rising While Progress Flat
rules.objective: Detect WBS periods where cost continues to rise but physical progress barely changes.
rules.logic: For latest two comparable periods: cost_change_pct >= 20% AND progress_change_pp <= 2 points.
rules.threshold: Default cost +20% and progress change <=2 pp; materiality floor applies.
rules.evidence: Two-period cost totals, progress values, top transactions.
rules.finding: WBS {wbs} cost increased {cost_change_pct} while progress changed only {progress_change_pp}.
rules.impact: Possible productivity loss, stalled workfront, advance procurement, or coding issue.
rules.recommendation: Reconcile cost to installed quantities/progress and investigate top spend drivers.
rules.false_positive: Advance procurement and known front-loaded packages can be tagged expected.
rules.acceptance: Cost +25% with progress +1 pp triggers; cost +15% does not.

rules.name: Schedule Delay with High Cost Exposure
rules.objective: Prioritize WBSs where schedule delay and cost exposure coexist.
rules.logic: Trigger when WBS has overdue/critical delayed activity AND cost_exposure_pct >= 80% of budget OR actual_cost > 90% of budget.
rules.threshold: Default schedule delay + >=80% exposure; critical when exposure >=100%.
rules.evidence: Delayed activities, budget, actual/commitment exposure, progress.
rules.finding: WBS {wbs} combines schedule delay with {exposure_pct} cost exposure.
rules.impact: Higher probability of time and cost overrun occurring together.
rules.recommendation: Escalate WBS as integrated cost-schedule risk; review recovery, remaining budget, and forecast.
rules.false_positive: Planned front-loaded work must be marked expected and still monitored.
rules.acceptance: Delayed activity + 85% exposure creates critical finding; delayed + 60% exposure does not.
